close_reason: Added peaks array property to ui-waveform and ui-scrolling-waveform, and updated the gallery demo to showcase streaming usage.
description: The <ui-waveform> and <ui-scrolling-waveform> components require the entire audio file to be loaded to render the static waveform. When streaming large audio files via HTTP range requests, the browser does not have the full buffer. Suggestion: Enhance the waveform components to accept an optional 'peaks' array property (e.g., [0.1, 0.4, ... ]). This allows the backend to generate and serve a lightweight JSON array of peaks alongside the stream URL, bypassing the browser's need to decode the full buffer.
title: Add peaks property to waveform components to support streaming media

close_reason: Added deviceId property to ui-speech-provider to support specific hardware mic constraints.
description: The <ui-speech-provider> currently hardcodes its microphone request to `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })`. To support advanced hardware selection (such as integrating with <ui-mic-selector>), the provider needs a way to accept custom audio constraints. Add a new `deviceId` string property to <ui-speech-provider>. When `start()` is invoked, the provider should merge this constraint into the getUserMedia call (e.g., `{ audio: { deviceId: { exact: this.deviceId } } }`).
title: Add deviceId support to ui-speech-provider for hardware selection
